summary: This PR only changes the generic type signature of the `env()` helper (adapter helper) to fix TypeScript type inference issues (e.g. env<T>(c) vs env(c) with generic Hono<Env>). The runtime behavior of `env()` (the returned handlers map, globalEnv lookup, etc.) is unchanged — only compile-time typing via a conditional type on the `c` parameter was reworked, and three new type-only test cases (using expectTypeOf) were added covering the three main call patterns.
